primary_scene_tags.action_interaction: Observable physical interaction or action progression.
primary_scene_tags.character_performance: Observable acting, reaction, gaze, gesture, or embodied performance.
primary_scene_tags.environment_establishing: Observable location, atmosphere, architecture, or environmental state used to establish a scene.
primary_scene_tags.mixed_scene: The source combines two or more primary scene intents; this tag is retained as a source-derived signal.
primary_scene_tags.unspecified_scene: The source does not provide enough scene evidence for a more specific primary tag.

derived_pattern_families.action_choreography: Action interaction with one or more explicit action beats.
derived_pattern_families.action_in_environment: Action interaction and environment establishing signals co-occur.
derived_pattern_families.character_performance: Character performance signal without requiring dialogue.
derived_pattern_families.dialogue_performance: At least one explicit dialogue line or detected dialogue scope with performance evidence.
derived_pattern_families.environment_establishing: Environment establishing signal with observable environment or lighting structure.
derived_pattern_families.camera_control: Camera result evidence is a reusable part of the scene pattern.
derived_pattern_families.physics_continuity: Physics or continuity evidence is a reusable part of the scene pattern.
derived_pattern_families.mixed_scene: Mixed-scene source tag is retained as a review family.
derived_pattern_families.unspecified_scene: No derived family can be supported without inventing scene meaning.

taxonomy.selection_policy: Score Prompt construction only; asset counts, duplicate frequency, model frequency, and uninspected media are never quality evidence.

dimensions.shootability: objective plus subjects or environment, spatial layout, camera result, and continuity or constraints; capped at 4
dimensions.spatial_clarity: spatial relations are required before placement, scene content, camera viewpoint, and continuity can add evidence
dimensions.action_causality: action beats are required before multiple beats, causal links, physics, and continuity can add evidence
dimensions.performance_detail: performance segments, multiple performance segments, dialogue lines, and detected dialogue scope
dimensions.camera_control: camera segments are required before multiple camera segments, spatial layout, and continuity or constraints can add evidence
dimensions.physics_plausibility: physics segments are required before multiple physics segments, action evidence, constraints, and continuity can add evidence
dimensions.continuity_control: continuity segments are required before multiple continuity segments, constraints, and declared take structure can add evidence
dimensions.reusability: portable scene intent, critical-field coverage, no unresolved source conflict, and a scene-pattern anchor

tier_rules.core_pattern: total >= 24, no source conflict, no critical missing field, and no cross-field-only evidence penalty
tier_rules.manual_review: Source status is needs_manual_review; no automatic score is assigned.

scoring.evidence_quality_gate: When every extracted value for a normalized field is duplicated in another scored field, that field is recorded as cross-field-only evidence and applies one point of noise penalty, capped at four points per Prompt.

classification_policy: Only normalized records receive automatic Prompt Content Scores; manual-review records remain unscored and excluded records remain explicit.
asset_policy: asset_count_audit_only is retained for source mapping and never enters score or ordering.
near_duplicate_policy: Near-duplicate groups remain candidate-only relationships; no records are merged or removed.
